text.description_html:
Mul-T-Lock SMA-NZR-2KUSSB, SMARTair iClass/Mifare Wireless V3 Reader with Keypad

The SMARTair Wall Reader is allows access control for commercial and institutional facilities including offices, hospitals, factories, assisted living facilities, schools, sports clubs, and more. The Wall Reader operaties magnet locks, electric strikes, or electronic locks. Access can be granted via keycode, use of the smartphone app or by placing the access card or access fob near the reader. All the control elements are on the inside of the door to enhance security.

Features of the Smartair wireless Keypad Card Reader:

  • Simple installation
  • Simple operation
  • 4-digit code
  • Scales up to 64,000 user cards and up to 64,000 doors per system

Specifications of the SMARTair Wall Reader Universal Design:

  • 3.56 MHz, MIFARE® DESFire or iClass technology
  • Contactless cards/tags
  • 2-4 cm read/write distance
  • Temperature range: -10°C to 80°C
  • 12V AC/DC power
  • Consumption: Relay not active - 20µA; Relay active - 150mA
  • Relay: NO, NC, C
  • Wireless frequency: 868MHz or 915 MHz

Sold Individually
